Package com.foodorbit.application.service

Class DriverAssignmentService

java.lang.Object
com.foodorbit.application.service.DriverAssignmentService
public class DriverAssignmentService extends Object
Manages driver assignment for customer delivery orders. Selects eligible and available drivers based on delivery distance, order weight, and the selected assignment strategy. Supports automatic strategy selection according to order type and time-sensitive deliveries, such as ice cream orders.
Version:
1.0
Author:
FoodOrbit Team

  • Method Details

    • assignDriver

      public com.foodorbit.domain.driver.Driver assignDriver(List<com.foodorbit.domain.driver.Driver> drivers, double pickupX, double pickupY, double deliveryDistanceKm, double orderWeightKg)
      Assigns an eligible and available driver to a delivery order. Filters drivers based on their availability, maximum delivery distance, and supported order weight. The configured selection strategy chooses a driver from the eligible candidates. The selected driver's status is changed to BUSY.
      Parameters:
      drivers - the list of candidate drivers
      pickupX - the X coordinate of the pickup location
      pickupY - the Y coordinate of the pickup location
      deliveryDistanceKm - the delivery distance in kilometers
      orderWeightKg - the weight of the order in kilograms
      Returns:
      the selected driver, or null if no eligible driver is found

    • assignDriverByOrderType

      public com.foodorbit.domain.driver.Driver assignDriverByOrderType(List<com.foodorbit.domain.driver.Driver> drivers, double pickupX, double pickupY, double deliveryDistanceKm, double orderWeightKg, com.foodorbit.domain.order.OrderType orderType, boolean containsIceCream)
      Assigns a driver based on the order type and delivery requirements. Automatically selects the fastest driver strategy for EXPRESS orders or orders containing ice cream. For other order types, the nearest driver strategy is used. Only available drivers who satisfy the delivery distance and order weight requirements are considered. The selected driver's status is changed to BUSY.
      Parameters:
      drivers - the list of candidate drivers
      pickupX - the X coordinate of the pickup location
      pickupY - the Y coordinate of the pickup location
      deliveryDistanceKm - the delivery distance in kilometers
      orderWeightKg - the weight of the order in kilograms
      orderType - the type of order (STANDARD, EXPRESS, or SCHEDULED)
      containsIceCream - true if the order contains ice cream
      Returns:
      the selected driver, or null if no eligible driver is found
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if orderType is null
